answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms. A new identity must anchor itself by trading with 12 unrelated counterparties over 20 epochs. Each thread counts once, so 100 fakes from one wallet fail the test. Making 100 fakes needs 1,200 counterparties at 5 units of escrow each, 6,000 locked, against 30 units of reward per epoch, so the farm loses money. Honest agents pay one 5-unit escrow, keep an ivory seal of diversity, and earn full fees.
